# last-fixed: PAD-9
# pad <number> <width>: zero-pad a number to a width.
printf '%0*d\n' "$2" "$1"
EOF
tail -c1 CHANGES.txt | xxd | head -1
echo "PAD-9 | pad | zero-pad with %0*d instead of space padding" >> CHANGES.txt
